phenotype.definition: Among adult office visits with a recorded sinusitis diagnosis (acute or chronic), the share that also record a migraine or other headache diagnosis at the same visit. A direct look at the sinus-headache overlap the proposal targets, within physician-coded visits.

eligibility.reason: Adult visits with a recorded sinusitis diagnosis: the proposal 3.1 'sinus headache' presentation. The estimate is the share of those visits that also record a migraine or headache diagnosis.

questionText.headache_migraine: Migraine or other headache diagnosis. ICD-10-CM G43 migraine, G44 other headache syndromes, R51 headache; ICD-9-CM 346 migraine, 339 other headache syndromes, 784.0 headache.
questionText.dizziness_balance: Dizziness or vestibular diagnosis. ICD-10-CM R42 dizziness and giddiness, H81 disorders of vestibular function (including BPPV, vestibular neuronitis and Meniere disease), H82 vertiginous syndromes in diseases classified elsewhere; ICD-9-CM 780.4 dizziness and giddiness, 386 vertiginous syndromes. Meniere disease is a MASQUE discriminator in the screener but counts here as a dizziness diagnosis, matching the symptom-level surveys.
questionText.hearing_difficulty: Hearing loss diagnosis. ICD-10-CM H90 conductive and sensorineural hearing loss, H91 other and unspecified hearing loss; ICD-9-CM 389 hearing loss.
questionText.tinnitus: Tinnitus diagnosis. ICD-10-CM H93.1 tinnitus; ICD-9-CM 388.3 tinnitus.
questionText.sinus_condition: Sinusitis diagnosis. ICD-10-CM J01 acute sinusitis, J32 chronic sinusitis; ICD-9-CM 461 acute sinusitis, 473 chronic sinusitis. The first source in which the proposal 7.1 sinonasal arm is expressible.

caveats: Share of adult physician office visits in which the listed diagnoses were recorded, not a prevalence among people: a patient seen several times counts several times, and a condition not coded at the visit counts as absent.
Physician diagnoses abstracted from the visit record, up to five per visit; codes flagged probable, questionable or rule-out are excluded.
2015 is coded in ICD-9-CM and 2016-2019 in ICD-10-CM truncated to four characters. The code lists cover both, but the transition changes coding detail, so comparability across it is approximate.

Four survey years pooled (2015, 2016, 2018, 2019; 2017 not available) with weights divided by four, so totals are annual averages; proportions are unaffected by the division. Strata (CSTRATM) are year-specific.
Reason-for-visit codes are not used: the reason-for-visit classification list was not in the documentation supplied, so a complaint such as dizziness that was not also diagnosed is not counted.

Estimates are suppressed unless RSE is 30% or less, at least 30 visits are in the denominator, and at least 30 sample visits carry the phenotype (NCHS reliability standard for NAMCS visit estimates, applied to the numerator; stricter than NCHS's 2017 standard for proportions, which this ETL does not implement).
Hypothesis-generating estimate, not a diagnostic count.

Estimated within the eligible subpopulation only (AGE >= 18, sinus_condition positive): Adult visits with a recorded sinusitis diagnosis: the proposal 3.1 'sinus headache' presentation. The estimate is the share of those visits that also record a migraine or headache diagnosis..
Concepts this cycle could not express: recalcitrance_proxy. The phenotype reported here is narrower than the one defined in proposal 7.1.
No gender-identity item in this cycle: estimates are stratified by sex only. Gender is not substituted from sex.
